Generate the weekly KloudMate product digest for the period below.

## Period
Start: {{PERIOD_START}}
End:   {{PERIOD_END}}

## Change data
The following JSON array contains all normalized, classified change items collected from the configured repositories for this period. Each item includes heuristic priors for `visibility` (customer | internal | mixed | unknown) and `category` (new | changed | breaking | fix | internal). Use these as strong signals but apply your own judgment.

Infer the product area and likely docs area for each change from the repository name, changed file paths, PR title, and description. Do not rely on pre-classified mappings — reason about what part of the product each change affects.

```json
{{CHANGES_JSON}}
```

## Output format

Produce a single markdown document with the following structure **exactly**:

```
---
title: Weekly Product Digest — {{WEEK_LABEL}}
summary: Customer-facing product and documentation-impact summary for the week of {{PERIOD_START}}.
date: {{WEEK_LABEL}}
period_start: {{PERIOD_START}}
period_end: {{PERIOD_END}}
type: engineering-digest
---

# Weekly KloudMate Product Digest
Period: {{PERIOD_START}} to {{PERIOD_END}}

## Executive Summary
<2–4 sentence overview of the week's highlights>

## New
<bullet list of new customer-facing features/capabilities, or "_None this week._">

## Changed
<bullet list of changed behavior/config/UX, or "_None this week._">

## Breaking Changes
<bullet list of breaking changes with migration guidance if available, or "_None this week._">

## Fixes
<bullet list of user-visible fixes, or "_None this week._">

## Docs Impact
<structured list of likely documentation impact items — see format below, or "_None identified._">

## Internal / Excluded Notes
<brief summary of what was excluded and why, or "_None._">

## Source References
<list of all cited PRs and commits with URLs>
```

### Docs Impact item format

For each likely docs-impacting change, use:

```
- **<Product Area>**
  - Reason: <why docs may be impacted>
  - Likely docs area: <docs page group>
  - Confidence: High | Medium | Low
  - Evidence: <repo name> <PR #NNN or commit SHA>, `<relevant paths>`
```

Now generate the digest.
